issues.detail: Hebrew 'לְבֻשׁוֹ' means 'his garment' (referring to the cloud as clothing for the sea/creation), but Chinese renders '海的衣服' (the sea's clothing), adding '海' (sea) which is not in the Hebrew. The Hebrew has no explicit 'sea' here; it says 'when I made the cloud its garment' (i.e., the cloud as garment for the earth/creation). This addition changes the referent.
